description: OEM deployment overlay for scripts/materialize-application-registry.mjs. Copy this file per OEM customer and set the branding/domain fields. The default fast path keeps the application identities (tenant_id + backend.appId) unchanged so the committed public application tokens remain valid and the OEM deployment only re-brands names and domains. Changing tenantId or rewriting an appId also changes the application identity: regenerate the client env profiles for that identity (sdkwork-specs/tools/materialize-client-env.mjs) before building the frontends, otherwise the browser keeps sending tokens for the previous identity.
